issues.title: Success toasts disagree on punctuation and phrasing
issues.detail: Settings success toasts use the same component but two sentence styles: full sentences ending in a period, and terse fragments with no period. One toast adds 'successfully'; another uses a colon label.
issues.evidence: Exact toast strings: "Your company name has been updated." and "Your Mercury account is now connected to NetSuite." (period) vs "Job title updated", "New role created: AP Clerk" and "Security check-in triggered successfully" (no period). Personal settings add "Your preferred name has been updated." (period) vs "Opted in to SMS notifications" and "Invite sent" (no period).

issues.title: Connection status shown as a badge only when it fails
issues.detail: On Third party connections, the failed AMAZON Store shows a pink tag with a warning icon, but healthy stores show 'Connected' as plain body text with no tag. Team and Roles show every status, healthy ones included, as a green 'Active' tag, so healthy status looks different here than on sibling tables.
issues.evidence: getComputedStyle: 'No connection' tag 12px/400 rgb(252,146,180) on rgba(252,146,180,0.2), radius 4px, padding 0 8px, height 20px. 'Connected' (Third party and Integrations tabs) 15px/400 rgb(255,255,255), no background, radius 0, in a 65px table cell. Team 'Active' tag 12px/400 rgb(119,197,153) on rgba(119,197,153,0.2), radius 4px, padding 0 8px, height 20px.

issues.title: Dates use three formats across security and API pages
issues.detail: Account Security shows activity timestamps as numeric month/day with no year, the card header as an abbreviated month name, and API Tokens shows full dates with the year. None of the three matches the others.
issues.evidence: Account Security activity cell '09/24 9:11 PM' 15px/400 rgb(255,255,255); header 'Last updated Sep 24' 12px/400 rgb(157,157,168). API Tokens Last used / Created date cells: 'May 16, 2019', 'Mar 14, 2019' 16px/360.

issues.title: API Tokens table truncates key columns and wraps another
issues.detail: Equal-width columns cut off token nicknames and creator emails with an ellipsis, while 'Whitelisted IPs' wraps '2 IPs whitelisted' onto two lines. That row ends up taller than the rest, and the two values you need to identify a token cannot be read without hovering.
issues.evidence: All seven columns render 138px wide; text boxes clip at 106px with text-overflow: ellipsis: 'Token with long IPv6 address' needs 186px, 'My read-write Mercury API token' 214px, 'jane@demo.mercury.com' 175px, 'landon@demo.mercury.com' 193px. Cells 16px/360. '2 IPs whitelisted' wraps onto two lines while '1 IP whitelisted' fits on one.

issues.title: Page headings don't match their sidebar labels
issues.detail: Several settings pages are titled differently from the sidebar item that opens them, so the selected nav item and the page heading disagree.
issues.evidence: Sidebar link texts 'Tokens', 'Vault', 'Company Profile'; resulting h1 texts 'API Tokens', 'Mercury Vault', 'Mercury Demo'. Account Security is the exception: sidebar and h1 both read 'Account Security'. Sidebar 'Profile' opens an h1 reading the user's name, 'Jane Black'.

issues.title: Tags and buttons mix Title Case and sentence case
issues.detail: Within Vault, two tags on neighbouring cards use different casing. The role editor's primary button is Title Case while the button that opens it is sentence case. A third-party store name is in all caps next to sentence-case siblings.
issues.evidence: Vault tags, both 12px/400, radius 4px, padding 0 8px: 'Transfer in Progress' (rgba(141,164,245,0.2) bg) vs 'Up to $220M FDIC insured' (rgba(119,197,153,0.2) bg). /settings/roles button 'Create role' vs /settings/roles/create primary 'Save New Role'. Third party connections: 'AMAZON Store' vs 'Shopify Store 1', 'My Stripe Store'.

issues.title: Security events use the verb 'Log in' as a noun
issues.detail: The activity history event reads 'Log in failure' (verb form) where the noun 'Login' is meant.
issues.evidence: Activity history Event column: "Log in failure", beside "Two-factor auth disabled", "Password changed", "Device forgotten".

issues.title: A token created now shows 'Tomorrow' and a placeholder creator
issues.detail: Creating an API token in the evening (US Pacific) adds a row whose Last used and Created date both read 'Tomorrow'. The date looks computed in UTC and printed as a relative word, while every other row uses an absolute date. The creator is 'mocked@mercury.com', not the signed-in user, and the permission reads 'Custom' although the option was 'Custom Scopes'.
issues.evidence: Browser clock via eval: 'Thu Sep 24 2026 21:48:36 GMT-0700 (Pacific Daylight Time)', timeZone America/Los_Angeles. New row: 'Map audit token | Custom | Tomorrow | mocked@mercury.com | Tomorrow | 1 IP whitelisted'. Existing rows: 'May 16, 2019', 'Apr 15, 2019', created by 'jane@demo.mercury.com'.

issues.title: Editing a webhook URL clears its event subscriptions
issues.detail: In Edit webhook endpoint, changing the URL resets the Event types combobox from the saved selection to the empty 'All events' placeholder. Someone fixing a typo in the URL either has to re-pick every event or ends up subscribed to all of them.
issues.evidence: Accessibility snapshot before editing: combobox "Event types": 3 selected. After filling the URL field and tabbing away: combobox "Event types" with no value, placeholder 'All events', and a new 'Verify endpoint' button. The detail panel lists 3 subscriptions (transaction.created, transaction.updated, checkingAccount.balance.updated).

issues.title: One orange means paused, failed, eligible and personal
issues.detail: The same orange tag colour marks a paused endpoint, a failed delivery, a passkey that is merely eligible to sync, and the neutral 'Personal Banking' referral kind. Meanwhile 'Needs attention' uses the pink reserved for form errors. Colour can't tell the reader whether something is broken.
issues.evidence: Text / background via getComputedStyle: 'Paused' rgb(252,155,111) / rgba(252,155,111,0.2); 'Failed' rgb(252,155,111) / rgba(252,155,111,0.2); 'Personal Banking' rgb(252,155,111) / rgba(252,155,111,0.2); 'Sync eligible' rgb(252,155,111) text only, 13px. 'Needs attention' rgb(252,146,180) / rgba(252,146,180,0.2), the same pink as validation text rgb(252,146,180).

issues.title: Notification channel labels are styled as success statuses
issues.detail: On Notifications, the Email and Push labels use the green success badge, and 'Off' uses the neutral badge. These are the tokens used for 'Active', 'Delivered' and 'Paid' on other pages, so a channel name reads like a status.
issues.evidence: 'Email' tag: color rgb(119,197,153), background rgba(119,197,153,0.2), 12px — identical to webhook 'Active'/'Delivered' and referral 'Paid'. 'Off': rgb(221,221,229) on rgba(180,183,200,0.28), identical to webhook 'Disabled' and 'Pending'.

issues.title: Required and invalid fields are reported four different ways
issues.detail: Empty required fields say 'Please complete this field' in most forms but 'This field is required' on Profile. An empty webhook URL shows nothing and just disables the button. A missing but required IP whitelist reuses the format error. The referral form hides its error in a hover tooltip instead of the inline message every other form uses.
issues.evidence: Exact strings: 'Please complete this field' (Create API token, Invite a user, Create role); 'This field is required' (Edit preferred name); 'Enter a comma-separated list of IPv4/6 addresses or CIDR ranges.' for an empty required IP whitelist; tooltip 'Please submit a valid email' on the Send to field. Inline messages are 12px rgb(252,146,180).

issues.title: Primary buttons disagree on whether to disable or validate
issues.detail: 'Create token' stays enabled on an empty form and reports errors on click, while 'Create endpoint' stays disabled until the URL is verified and 'Confirm' (referral) until an address is added. Nothing tells the user why the disabled buttons won't respond.
issues.evidence: Snapshot on open: button "Create token" (enabled); button "Create endpoint" [disabled], still disabled with a valid unverified https URL, enabled only after 'Verified'; button "Confirm" [disabled]; button "Update token" [disabled] until a field changes.

issues.title: Three one-time secrets, three different save safeguards
issues.detail: The webhook signing secret, the API token and backup codes are all shown once, but they use three different components. Only backup codes offer explicit Copy / Download / Print and block closing until the user confirms. The other two close with an X, and the webhook secret's copy action is an unlabelled button.
issues.evidence: Signing secret: accessible name of the copy control is the secret itself (button "whsec_mock_dGhp…"), feedback is a 'Copied' tooltip, close is an X. API token: 'Here is your API token', X close. Backup codes: full-screen, buttons 'Print', 'Download', 'Copy', checkbox 'I’ve saved my backup codes in a secure place' gating a disabled 'Done'.

issues.title: Delete confirmations use three templates
issues.detail: The three destructive dialogs in API and Security differ in title form, casing, button label, quoting and the 'cannot be undone' sentence. Deleting a token also gives no toast.
issues.evidence: Titles/buttons: 'Delete endpoint?' / 'Delete'; 'Delete API Token' / 'Delete Token'; 'Remove passkey' / 'Remove'. Bodies end 'This action cannot be undone.' (webhook, token) vs 'This cannot be undone.' (passkey). Token name in curly quotes “Map audit token”; webhook URL unquoted.

issues.title: Timestamps take four more forms in API and personal pages
issues.detail: In addition to the formats already logged, webhooks print 24-hour times with seconds, personal Security drops the year for recent dates but keeps it for older ones in the same column (and shows 12:00 AM on every row), and Profile prints the date of birth numerically.
issues.evidence: 'Feb 18, 2026 01:14:32' (webhook Last delivery / Timestamp); 'Sep 14 at 12:00 AM' and 'Sep 24, 2025 at 12:00 AM' in the same 'Most recent activity' column; Date of birth '01/31/1990'; webhook Created Date 'Nov 2, 2025'.

issues.title: Settings tables use three body sizes and two empty-cell glyphs
issues.detail: Table body text is 16px on API Tokens, 14px on Webhooks and Referrals and 13px on personal Security. Empty cells use a minus sign on Security and an em dash on Referrals. Webhooks writes 'Created Date' where Tokens writes 'Created date'.
issues.evidence: getComputedStyle font-size/weight of a date cell: Tokens 16px/360; Webhooks 'Nov 2, 2025' 14px/400; Referrals 'Mar 4, 2018' 14px/400; Security 'Sep 14 at 12:00 AM' 13px/400. Empty cell characters: U+2212 (Security YubiKey activity) vs U+2014 (Referrals payout). Header strings 'Created Date' (13px) vs 'Created date'.

issues.title: Referrals mixes money formats and its numbers don't add up
issues.detail: The same page and email preview write amounts with and without cents and abbreviate $10K next to $10,000. The totals also disagree with the table and the tier track.
issues.evidence: '$250.00 Referral Bonus', '$250.00 paid on Mar 4, 2018' vs 'You each get $250…', 'the $500 Gold bonus', 'Total earned $900'; 'deposits $10K' vs preview 'Deposit $10,000'. Paid rows total $250.00 + $500.00 = $750, not $900. '4 approved referrals unlock Gold bonus' while the Gold tier reads '10 referrals'.

issues.title: 'Log out' and 'Sign out' sit side by side
issues.detail: Personal Security uses both verbs for the same action within one section, and switches between 'sign in' and 'log in' across the page and its dialogs.
issues.evidence: Section button 'Log out other sessions' above per-row 'Sign out'; checkbox 'Log out of all other devices'; 'Sign in faster…' vs 'It can’t be used to log in once removed' and 'Unable to log in?'.

issues.title: Title Case headings and buttons sit next to sentence-case twins
issues.detail: Several new dialogs and buttons use Title Case where the control that opens them, or a sibling label, is sentence case.
issues.evidence: 'Change password' button opens 'Change Password' with labels 'Old Password', 'New Password', 'Repeat New Password'; 'Download statements' opens 'Download Statements'; 'Generate New Codes'; 'Opt In'; 'Share your Mercury Referral'; section headings 'Important Updates' / 'General Updates'; referral status 'Account Opened' vs stat tile 'Account opened'.

issues.title: Dialog actions change weight and alignment from one dialog to the next
issues.detail: The only action in notification dialogs is a secondary 'Done', while the Download Statements dialog closes with a primary 'Close'. Verify-identity actions sit left while others sit right. In the token menu, Edit's icon is accent blue and Delete's is grey.
issues.evidence: 'Done' background rgba(180,183,200,0.12), text rgb(221,221,229), 40px tall; 'Close' background rgb(82,102,235), text rgb(255,255,255). Token menu icon fills: Edit rgb(141,164,245), Delete rgb(112,112,125).

issues.title: API token row menus have no accessible name
issues.detail: The ••• buttons on API Tokens expose no text or aria-label, so a screen reader announces three identical unnamed buttons with no token to tell them apart.
issues.evidence: Accessibility snapshot: each token row ends with 'button [expanded=false]' containing 'button' with no name. eval: 11 buttons in the page with empty innerText and no aria-label.

issues.title: Long option lists escape their modal
issues.detail: The Scopes list in Create an API token opens upward past the modal and slides under the fixed demo banner, hiding its first options. The webhook Event types list hangs below the modal's bottom edge.
issues.evidence: Screenshot 96: first visible option 'Fetch Account Statements' sits at the banner's lower edge and the Accounts group header is hidden; 28 options total. Screenshot 85: the list's last option 'creditAccount.balance.updated' sits below the modal frame.

issues.title: Some actions finish without updating the page
issues.detail: A newly created webhook endpoint never appears in the list. Regenerating backup codes leaves the Added on and Most recent activity dates unchanged. Referral rows announce themselves as links but do nothing when clicked. Event deliveries are not sorted by time.
issues.evidence: Endpoints rows after creating 'https://hooks.demo-startup.com/mercury': the same 6 URLs. Backup codes row after Done: '(8/8 remaining) | Aug 15 at 12:00 AM | Sep 9 at 12:00 AM'. Referrals table text 'This table row is also a link…'; clicking Widgets Inc. leaves URL /settings/referrals with no dialog. Delivery timestamps in row order: Feb 18 01:14:32, Feb 17 17:12:44, Feb 18 00:45:00, Feb 17 17:30:00, Feb 18 04:00:00.

issues.title: Sentence-ending periods inside link text
issues.detail: Inline links that end a sentence include the sentence's period, so the period is underlined and clickable. On Categories the intro ends 'Map these categories to GL codes in accounting settings.' with the period inside the link; on Approval Rules > Dual admin the 'Learn more.' link after the description includes its period, before the chevron icon.
issues.evidence:
DOM (2026-09-25): accounting settings. inside the Categories intro

; on /settings/approvals/dualAdmin Learn more. inside the Dual admin description (twice: page body and the policy

blocked: Books product: mapped by a separate agent, not in this manifest.
Perks (sidebar, under Explore) links to https://mercury.com/perks with target=_blank, outside the demo, so it is not mapped.
